name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Funding cuts and program changes required by President Trump's big budget law are forcing states to rethink bipartisan efforts to bring Medicaid into jails and prisons. (Image credit: Ramon Dompor for Tradeoffs).

changes.title: Trump-backed candidates, 2020 election deniers, win Arizona primaries
changes.summary: The primaries set the field for what are expected to be heated contests for Congress and governor in a swing state this fall. (Image credit: Ross D. Franklin).

changes.title: Trump has campaigned more so far in 2026 midterms than he did at this point in 2018
changes.summary: Heading to Georgia on Wednesday, President Trump is campaigning more often this year than he did in the same period for 2018 and has already rallied for a dozen candidates in toss-up races. (Image credit: Roberto Schmidt).

changes.title: Laredo’s Future Rides on Trump’s Next Trade Move
changes.summary: The economy of Laredo, Texas, has boomed under the president’s global tariffs. Now, his demands may threaten its success.

changes.title: ‘It’s a stone around your neck’: Arizona Republicans once again nominate 2020 election deniers
changes.summary: To make it out of a Republican primary in Arizona, there’s one key litmus test: believing the 2020 election was stolen from Donald Trump. Election deniers who played prominent roles in efforts to overturn the 2020 results triumphed in statewide Republican primaries Tuesday: Rep. Andy Biggs for governor , state Rep. Ale.

changes.title: Arizona Elections: 6 Takeaways From the Trump-Dominated Primaries
changes.summary: Republicans nominated a former N.F.L. kicker in a top House battleground, a Trump loyalist for governor and an election denier for the state’s top election post.

changes.title: Trump’s 50% Tariffs on Canada: What to Know, and What’s Next
changes.summary: The president said punishing 50 percent tariffs would begin by Aug. 19, a significant escalation of the trade war between Canada and the U.S. that he started over a year ago.

changes.title: Sen. Bennet rails against trade chief for Trump policy's impact on farmers
changes.summary: Sen. Michael Bennet, a Democrat from Washington, challenged some of U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer's assertions about the successes of President Trump's trade policies and their impact on farmers.

changes.title: Trump threatens to attack Iran's infrastructure over Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: President Trump in a social media post threatened to attack Iran's infrastructure if the Iranian military shoots at ships in the Strait of Hormuz. CBS News' Natalie Brand and Charlie D'Agata have more.

changes.title: Andy Biggs wins Republican nomination to challenge Democrat Katie Hobbs for Arizona governor
changes.summary: Biggs, a fierce ally of President Donald Trump and former head of the House Freedom Caucus, won the Republican nomination for Arizona governor Tuesday.
